'''Barsine''' was a city of [[Jaramide]], one of the [[Ten Nations]].{{ref|{{bwb}}, Rise and Fall of the Ten Nations}} It was famed for its golden spires and the lace it exported. Barsine was the first major city destroyed during the [[Trolloc Wars]] circa [[1000 AB]], and its fall was the first sign that the [[Trolloc]] raids were of a greater intensity and more significant than normal.
